description: Cookbook: at session start, says when a daily update report is waiting (reads ~/.local/share/stack-updates only); at session start, on a prompt and after a tool, says which model the usage budget asks for (reads the Claude usage at a session start, at most once per ten minutes, and the reading T3 Code saves when that read is refused; writes ~/.local/share/model-budget only); before a T3 tool starts an agent that is not Claude, runs the Codex start check and denies a start it refuses or cannot check (recipes/codex.md); after a question dialog, writes the question and the owner's answer to a list on this PC (~/.local/share/claude-cookbook/owner-answers only), and before one, stops it once to show what other chats asked; before a T3 tool starts a new chat, stops it once to look at the chats that exist (recipes/parallel-chats.md); at a turn's end, stops once a closing message that leaves an owner question unasked or a finished T3 chat unsettled (recipes/owner-questions.md).
